what.text: This page follows internal displacement in the Dominican Republic, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters rose from 383 in 2017 to 7872 in 2022.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for the Dominican Republic list floods and storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for the Dominican Republic.

when.text: The count fell to 54 by 2025; 2022 is the main year of displacement in the data.
IDMC records these figures year by year.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 30808 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside the Dominican Republic.
